verdict.rationale: Nitrokey ships an official CLI (nitropy) and a Python SDK, so an API reference is a fair question for this product. However, the evidence shows no interactive API reference or runnable examples, and the OpenAPI/Swagger probes all returned 404. A CLI and an SDK on PyPI are developer building blocks, not an interactive, runnable API reference.

support.subject: As an AI-native user, I can explore an interactive API reference with runnable examples
